english.title: Individual producer fail to notify Natural Resources Wales of relevant circumstances - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was an individual producer of packaging waste that failed to inform Natural Resources Wales, as soon as was practicable upon becoming aware, that a relevant circumstance applied or was about to apply, namely

(A)_[a moratorium had been granted in a debt relief order]_
(B)_[a composition or arrangement had been made with creditors]_
(C)_[a receiver or trustee in bankruptcy had been duly appointed]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 18 and 28(2)(c) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: Please note, there is an error in regulation 28(2)(c) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023 which creates this offence. Regulation 28(2)(c) refers to regulation 19 however, this appears to be an error and should in fact state regulation 18 as per the offence wording and details above.
